name: upstream-semantic-origin-reasoning

checks.name: semantic-origin input is a closed upstream evidence type
semantic-origin output is a closed judgment
origin resolver is declared as an upstream interface
origin authority uses a total declarative Record over the closed source-kind union
authority resolves model/controller/service/resource origins
authority returns a frozen closed judgment with evidence provenance
semantic producer delegates origin decisions to authority
semantic producer no longer owns source-family origin classification
origin contract exported from upstream barrel
origin authority and contract exposed through public package surface
query dispatch helper exists before catalog initialization
query dispatch entries are immutable
Phase 1409 audit remains registered
package identity and build command remain unchanged
ecommerce Laravel fixture remains present
canonical route producer projects pre-resolved identity and does not infer it locally
CLI action grouping consumes upstream identity authority without local suffix registry
CLI SDK emitter projects the resolved operation identity capability
SDK refuses missing operation identity instead of inventing a fallback
React hook runtime consumes explicit CRUD execution slots
manifest builder delegates semantic dataflow judgments to the injected upstream manifest surface
IR projection consumes closed authority state rather than rebuilding closure
Zod output mapping remains a projection from canonical type mapping

residuals: Semantic-origin resolution now has an upstream interface and authority, but model accessor eligibility remains a separate producer-side rule and should become a closed capability judgment.
Other Laravel source families beyond model/resource/controller/service still require migration onto the evidence -> syntax -> semantic judgment path.
Full build and runtime integration tests must run with the repository dependency toolchain installed.
flow: Laravel evidence -> syntax contract -> upstream semantic-origin judgment -> AST/ADT + dataflow judgment -> wiring -> runtime executor -> manifest/graph/IR/CLI/SDK/React
